Signode expands pallet AMR portfolio to connect packaging and storage

Lifting robots, pallet trucks and forklift configurations extend material flow beyond end-of-line packaging.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗22 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

More configurations for pallet handling

On October 22, Signode expanded its AMR portfolio with lifting robots, pallet trucks, counterbalanced forklifts, reach trucks and stacker forklifts. These move completed pallet loads between production, storage and distribution, with configurations selected for lifting and load requirements.

Connecting movement and storage

Signode says the robots navigate without fixed floor lines or magnetic strips and can reroute around obstructions. Deployments are designed to integrate warehouse and fleet-management software, including pallet delivery into StorFast ASRS to connect packaging, transport and storage.

Scaling fleets with demand

Customers can add capacity and capabilities over time. Signode cites one warehouse with more than 17 robots; its broader figure of over 800 vehicles across more than 80 locations is not a sales total for the new models. Individual prices and performance specifications were not detailed.
